title: A Asset for the Contact
author: W. M. Marchetti
blurb: August Okonkwo, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
